This matches what Mark wrote: *"Let's meet at the island trailhead at 8 AM on Saturday 18th."*

⚠️ One heads-up: you have an existing **Dentist Appointment on 2024-05-18 from 09:00–10:00** (Downtown Dental Clinic), which overlaps with the hike. The emails didn't mention rescheduling it, so I left it untouched — let me know if you'd like me to move or cancel it.

Also note that Mark's address (mark.davies@hotmail.com) is external to bluesparrowtech.com.
